tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search the public Fenua Spot directory (French Polynesia). Filter with ile, categorie (slug from list_categories) and activite (plongee, snorkeling, sortie-baleines, survol, excursions, randonnee, surf, kayak, voile, quad, jet-ski, paddle, kitesurf, peche-sportive, sport, dauphins, raies, musee, dan

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One public fiche by slug. The description is the full public text. Offers include prices and booking links. The canonical https://www.fenuaspot.com URL comes first. Several islands can share a slug. Phone, email, website, address, hours and coordinates stay on the fiche.

tools.name: search_spots
tools.description: Search public places (beaches, passes, viewpoints), category spots. Not businesses. Each row starts with the canonical fiche URL, a one-sentence description, offers and booking links. Phone, email, website, address, hours and coordinates stay on the fiche. Default 5, maximum 10.

tools.name: get_spot
tools.description: One public spot by slug. The description is the full public text. The canonical fiche URL comes first. Phone, email, website, address, hours and coordinates stay on the fiche.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Public travel guides, written pages and guide fiches. Optional island filter. Canonical URL on each row. Default 5, maximum 10.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Public events that have not ended. from and to are ISO dates or datetimes; a date alone is a Tahiti civil day. Past events are omitted. Canonical URL on each row. Default 5, maximum 10.

tools.name: list_islands
tools.description: Island slugs to pass as ile. Each row has the canonical island URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Category slugs to pass as categorie. Labels are French, as on the site.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, search_spots, get_spot, list_guides, list_events, list_islands · Public sink: search_listings, get_listing, search_spots, get_spot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing, search_spots, get_spot, list_guides, list_events, list_islands · Public sink: search_listings, get_listing, search_spots, get_spot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
